BiblicalUsage: Nachnu is the pronoun we, and it is the voice of people speaking together about who they are. In Exodus 16:7 Moses asks, what are we, that ye murmur against us, when the people complain in the wilderness, and in Genesis 42:11 Joseph's brothers say, we are all one man's sons, we are true men, and not spies.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that we is the hardest word in the Bible to say honestly, because it ties my name to my neighbour's; the brothers said we and meant it, and the murmurers said we and blamed Moses for it.
